## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (65%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
In situ carcinoma (24%) stays in the 90% prediction set [F1], and 0/5 similar cases are Benign [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 65%, InSitu 24%, Normal 11%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; minimal invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude in situ carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC despite stain shift |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (4 Normal, 1 InSitu) | Neighbors disagree with Benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.792 contribution); 0/20 spot check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.407 contribution) pushing away from invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.372 contribution); 0/20 spot check is unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.332 contribution); 12/20 spot-checked regions acceptable · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Mildly elevated score (+0.187 contribution); 19/20 spot-checked regions acceptable · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); relies on Unreliable normal lobules and mitotic figures (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- In situ carcinoma (24% probability) is present or requires drafted deeper levels to expose ductal atypia.
- Simulated severity-3 stain degradation (94th OOD percentile) or normal tissue (4/5 neighbors) misleads the Benign call.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 2, 11**: Highest heatmap risk regions (5%, 2%, 1%), including stromal infiltration signal in region 11.
2. **Regions 4, 7, 8**: Inspect ducts and lobules to separate Benign, Normal, and InSitu; consider drafted deeper levels.
3. **Regions 1, 7, 8, 11**: Confirm clear surgical margins [F7] where border segment scores reach 95%–98%.
